canonical_claim.template: In 2025, {value} of the 977,621 VA applications that lenders acted on were approved but not accepted by the applicant.

required_qualifiers.population: VA applications acted on (actions 1-5; purchased loans and preapproval requests excluded; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.denominator: applications acted on, not decisioned applications

does_not_establish: why any application ended where it did
a comparison with the VA denial rate on decisioned applications without restating both denominators
a comparison across programs as a judgement of programs or lenders
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
